name: canvas-companion
description: Your Canvas courses inside Claude Code: sync materials, see what is due, track grades and todos, prep for class. Read-only against Canvas.

canvas_domain.title: Canvas domain
canvas_domain.description: Optional. Your school's Canvas address without https://, e.g. canvas.yourschool.edu. Leave blank and say "set up Canvas" in chat to look it up from your school's name.

canvas_token.title: Canvas access token
canvas_token.description: Optional. Leave blank and say "set up Canvas" in chat: the assistant opens the token page and saves the token you copy. By hand: Canvas -> Account -> Settings -> + New Access Token (students: at most 120 days).

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Leave blank on first install. Ask 「Canvas Companion 授权状态」 for your device id and a link to apply; paste the CC1-… key here once approved.
